prompt:
I've been using an AI assistant workspace for my consulting practice for about a year now and it's become a complete mess. Every time I start a new session, it's forgotten what we were working on. I have way too many AI 'agents' that overlap and confuse each other — there's one for research, one for business dev, one for ops, a lab for experiments, even an analytics sidecar. My scheduled tasks say vague things like 'do things every hour' and reference no real files. My notes file has become a junk drawer with grocery lists mixed in with actual client insights. I have one active project called 'phoenix' that desperately needs proper documentation — it has a product brief but nothing tracking actual progress or next steps.

I need you to reorganize this entire workspace following the proper architecture for a durable personal operating system. The end result should be: a clean agent setup where only the essential agents remain and each has a clearly defined role and isolated memory; a proper multi-tiered memory system where important truths are curated separately from daily logs and topic-specific knowledge; complete project documentation for the phoenix project; a working automation plan that specifies concrete schedules and references actual files in the workspace; and a clear improvement loop so the system can get better over time. Please do whatever restructuring, file creation, and cleanup is needed to get there.
